# NATCH CART

> NATCH CART (natchcart.com) is an Indian online store for spiritual products, gemstone bracelets, malas, Vastu essentials, chakra accessories and traditional products inspired by Indian spiritual practices. It aims to make spirituality part of everyday life, whether for daily practice, a peaceful home space, or a meaningful gift.

Key facts:
- Brand name: NATCH CART (site name: Natch Cart India)
- Website: https://natchcart.com/
- Product types: gemstone bracelets, Rudraksha and sacred malas, crystal accessories, Pyrite (Dhan Yog) anklets, energy/pyramid cones, Vastu essentials
- Currency: INR (Rs.)
- Shipping: free shipping on prepaid orders (as shown on the homepage)

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://natchcart.com/): Overview of the brand, featured collections and bestsellers
